item.title: California voters defeat billionaire tax proposal that divided Democrats
item.description: The novel proposal would have charged billionaires a one-time 5% tax on most of their overall wealth, including their ownership in companies.

item.title: France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks
item.description: France says Iranian military hackers took over refrigeration controllers at around 700 different retail sites last month, turning up temperatures in the middle of the night and spoiling millions of dollars' worth of food.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: College Football Playoff will expand to 24 teams in another sea change for the sport
item.description: The College Football Playoff is expanding again. The 12-team format lasted just three years. Starting next fall, the field will expand to 24 teams in a massive moment of transformation for the sport.
item.content:encoded: The College Football Playoff is expanding again. The 12-team format lasted just three years. Starting next fall, the field will expand to 24 teams in a massive moment of transformation for the sport.

item.title: Turkey hosts world climate summit, but some critics accuse it of 'greenwashing'
item.description: Thousands of diplomats, executives and leaders are gathering in Turkey for a global climate summit. In recent years, Turkey has moved to be more eco-conscious, but some say that hasn't been enough.

item.title: Apocalyptic sci-fi novel 'The End of Everything' wins this year's Booker Prize
item.description: M. John Harrison's slim novel is the first Booker Prize winner that's "emerged from the bona fide [sci-fi] world," according to the Booker Prize Foundation's chief executive.

item.title: Supreme Court says border wall construction can continue in west Texas
item.description: The Trump administration filed an emergency relief request with the high court earlier in October asking for the construction to continue while a lawsuit over the plan moves forward.

item.title: We are still puzzling over the mysteries of Edgar Allan Poe and Arthur Conan Doyle
item.description: Both Poe and Doyle have generated mountains of literary criticism over the years, but Darkness Becomes Bright and Sleuth-Hound remind us there's a lot left to discover about these masters.

item.title: Thick smog shrouds New Delhi after Diwali firecrackers add to seasonal pollution
item.description: New Delhi, home to over 30 million people, regularly ranks among the world's most polluted areas during winter, with pollution worsening in late October and November.

item.title: British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault
item.description: Russell Brand, who became a celebrity darling in the early 2000s, was found guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault in a case brought by six women.
